text:
“Nepali fashion doesn’t have an identity”. I read this comment recently and thought to myself? Bffr! Yes we do! 

Fashion is universal, south asian fashion even more. I feel like we get listed as “desi” all the time even though we’re not, as a Nepali the influence is there but so is tibet, china, mongolia etc. But i do think we all each have our identities. And im here to show a part of it <3
